title: Harmony checker misranks single-voice timbre auditions
description: When comparing isolated single-note sample voices, the harmony objective can rank a perceptually noisy source above cleaner alternatives. The consonance implementation only accumulates pairwise clash across different stems; a one-stem audition therefore has no within-stem spectral-noise penalty. The first A/B/C experiment also revealed that comparisons across different absolute keys/chord maps are not metrically comparable. Define and test a timbre-aware, same-context audition measure before using objective_v2 to recommend a sample voice.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Investigate with a controlled same-key/register/rhythm/effects comparison, measure actual source pitch/noise, and attribute score components before proposing analyzer changes. Prior diagnosis is a hypothesis rather than an established cause.
